camel_example: aliyun nas SetDirQuota --region cn-hangzhou --Path '/data/sub1' --QuotaType Accounting --FileSystemId 1ca4040000 --UserType Uid
description_en: Sets a directory quota for a file system
description_zh: 设置文件系统的目录配额
kebab_example: aliyun nas set-dir-quota --file-system-id 1ca4040000 --path /data/sub1 --quota-type Accounting --user-type Uid --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDirQuota

parameters.help_en:
The absolute path of the directory in the file system.
You can set a quota only for a directory that has been created in the NAS file system. The directory path for the quota is the absolute path in the NAS file system, not the local path on a compute node (for example, an ECS instance or container).
Directories whose path names contain Chinese characters are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
目录在文件系统中的绝对路径。
仅支持为NAS文件系统中已创建的目录设置配额。配额的目录路径就是目录在NAS文件系统的绝对路径，而不是计算节点（例如，ECS，容器）上的本地路径。
不支持路径名中包含中文字符的目录
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en:
The quota type.

Valid values:
Accounting: statistical quota. Only tracks usage.
Enforcement: restrictive quota. When usage exceeds the limit, operations such as creating files or directories and appending data fail
parameters.help_zh:
配额类型。

取值：
Accounting：统计型配额，只统计使用量。
Enforcement：限制型配额，当使用量超过限制后，会导致创建文件或目录、追加写入等操作失败
parameters.name: quota_type

parameters.help_en:
The user type.

Valid values:

Uid: user ID
Gid: user group ID
AllUsers: all users
parameters.help_zh:
用户类型。

取值：

Uid：用户ID
Gid：用户所属组ID
AllUsers：所有用户
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en:
The UID or GID to restrict.

This parameter is required and valid only when UserType is set to Uid or Gid.

Examples:

To restrict the user whose UID is 500, set UserType to Uid and UserId to 500.
To restrict the user group whose GID is 100, set UserType to Gid and UserId to 100
parameters.help_zh:
要限制的Uid或Gid。

当UserType=Uid或Gid时必填且有意义。

例如：

要限制Uid=500的用户，则UserType填Uid，UserId填500。
要限制Gid=100的用户组，则UserType填Gid，UserId填100
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The total capacity limit for files in the directory.

Unit: GiB.


When QuotaType is set to Enforcement, you must specify at least one of SizeLimit and FileCountLimit
parameters.help_zh:
限制目录下文件总容量。

单位：GiB


当QuotaType=Enforcement时，SizeLimit和FileCountLimit至少填写其中一项
parameters.name: size_limit

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of files in the directory.

This includes files, directories, and special files.


When QuotaType is set to Enforcement, you must specify at least one of SizeLimit and FileCountLimit
parameters.help_zh:
限制目录下文件数目。

包括文件、目录和特殊文件。


当QuotaType=Enforcement时，SizeLimit和FileCountLimit至少填写其中一项
parameters.name: file_count_limit

Success.description_en:
The request status.

Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求状态。

包括：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
